definition: Set this style beside another and read the two together: how the corpus tells them apart, the kit slots where they differ, the proportion packs each carries and the plan types each is drawn with.
basis: schema/style-node.schema.json names each style's "Explicit disambiguation against commonly-confused neighbours." build/resolve_kit.py resolves a kit and "prints the result with the ancestor each binding came from", so two resolved kits can be read side by side, slot by slot.
